answer_1.quote: We aim to adapt the ICL paradigm to the attack scenario inspired by advICL , and investigate how the use of malicious demonstrations influences the efficacy of trustworthiness attacks, an area that has not been extensively studied.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include toxic, stereotypical, unethical, hallucinated, unfair, sycophantic, privacy-leaking, and robustness-violating responses induced via adversarial prompts.

answer_2.quote: We calculate the average toxicity score, ranging from 0 to 1, across all generated responses to measure the attack success.
